name: hum
description: Play any song for free while you work. Ask Claude for a song or a mood and it plays in a hum browser tab.
long_description: hum is a free music player that plays through YouTube's official embed. This extension lets Claude be the remote: ask for a song, an endless mood station, or a Spotify playlist link, then pause, skip, change the volume, or ask what is playing and which lyric line is being sung. The first time you ask for music, hum starts a small server on your machine and opens itself in your browser. Music plays in that browser tab, so click the tab once to let the browser allow sound. hum keeps no account and collects nothing about you. The only requests it makes are searches to YouTube Music, Spotify's public embed page for playlist links, and LRCLIB for lyrics.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Play a song by title, artist, or both. Music keeps going afterwards with similar songs.

tools.name: station
tools.description: Start an endless mix in a mood, genre, artist, or around a seed song.

tools.name: play_playlist
tools.description: Play a public Spotify playlist, album, or track link.

tools.name: control
tools.description: Pause, resume, skip to the next song, or go back to the previous one.

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: What is playing right now, the lyric line being sung, and what comes next.

port.title: Local port
port.description: Port hum uses on your machine. Change it only if 3737 is already taken.
